Hi team — I've reviewed the AcmeHealth DPA and the intake PDF. Initial notes: 

- Controller vs Processor: For AcmeHealth's Hosted deployment the DPA names Acme as controller and Redwood as processor. I will flag a footnote for Dedicated/private nuances in the evidence bundle.
- Export scope: data lives in primary DB (postgresql-prod-1), S3 archival buckets (s3://redwood-acme-archives), and Kafka topic retention snapshots. We can generate a consolidated export (export_bundle_user_5f3a.zip) that includes profile, messages, embeddings metadata, and app logs filtered to the user ID.
- Erasure: We have a multi-step erasure pipeline: mark/soft-delete in application layer -> background worker purge -> remove from analytic indices -> scrub from backups on retention expiration (can't guarantee immediate physical removal from immutable backup snapshots; need to document retention exception).

Required evidence to hand to AcmeHealth:
1) export_bundle_user_5f3a.zip (created by DataOps)
2) redwood_erasure_log.csv (timestamps, system IDs, job run IDs)
3) signed statement on controller/processor role + reference to SCCs and DPA clause (legal).

I'm starting the export job. ETA for export: 48 hours (by 2026-10-18 EOD). Erasure confirmation: depends on whether Acme requires immediate purge or is accepting staged deletion (we should get a clarification).

Evelyn Hart
